provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: [L166-L180] (MED/division by zero) progress_indicator permits dper equal to zero and then can evaluate mod(curper,dper), which is undefined for a zero divisor.
audit_member_text: [L151-L181] (MED/arithmetic-input-contract) progress_indicator does not require positive dper, dt, or count_rate; in particular dper=0 reaches mod(curper,dper) and divides by zero.

base_member_text: [L302-L313] (MED/division by zero) writelog_finalize divides by the timestep count n without guarding the valid lifecycle case in which finalization occurs before any execute step.
audit_member_text: [L304-L313] (MED/arithmetic) Final timing divides by timestep count n without guarding n=0, affecting both average timestep and performance calculations.

base_member_text: [L274-L280] (LOW/misleading diagnostic) The error==6 branch reports an excessive N-direction domain count but tells the user to reduce the M-direction count.
audit_member_text: [L274-L280] (LOW/diagnostic-accuracy) The error-6 warning describes an excessive N-direction split but tells the user to reduce MPI domains in the M direction.

base_member_text: [L84-L93] (MED/file-open error handling) The OPEN statements have no IOSTAT handling and the subsequent error test checks only whether a unit number was available, not whether any log file was successfully opened.
audit_member_text: [L84-L93] (HIGH/io-error-handling) Log-file OPEN statements have no iostat checks, while the reported error is based only on whether a positive unit number was found, so actual open failures are not detected.

base_member_text: [L67-L72] (HIGH/fixed-buffer overflow) logmsg passes an arbitrary-length message directly to string_to_char_array's fixed 1024-byte result without truncation or rejection, so messages of 1024 or more nonblank characters overflow the conversion buffer.

[L104-L110,L357-L365] (MED/diagnostic loss) Errors are written to XBerror.txt during execution but close_logfiles unconditionally closes that file with STATUS='DELETE', discarding the error log even after errors were recorded.

audit_member_text: [L16-L22,L53-L61] (MED/ffi/calling-convention) The procedure interface used for a C function pointer is not declared bind(C), so c_f_procpointer does not establish a portable interoperable callback calling convention.

[L50,L372] (HIGH/build-completeness) The module includes writeloginterface.inc and writelog.inc, but neither file exists under source_code, leaving the logging API dependent on absent generated artifacts.
[L76-L100] (HIGH/uninitialized-status) start_logfiles never initializes error to zero, leaves it untouched on non-master ranks, and later tests it on every rank.
[L161-L181] (LOW/timer-wraparound) The saved system_clock baseline does not account for count_max rollover, which can suppress time-based progress reports after wraparound.
[L375-L386] (LOW/dead-code) assignlogdelegate_internal declares local integer i but never uses it, suggesting incomplete delegate setup or stale code.
